faqs.a: Measure your child's foot length in cm. GIMKOUNN roller shoes feature an adjustable 4-size system covering 3 EU sizes per pair. Check our size chart or contact us for personalized sizing advice.
faqs.q: How do I choose the right size?

faqs.a: 22-25 EUR = 14-16 cm insole (3-6 yrs). 26-30 EUR = 16.5-19 cm (7-12 yrs). 31-35 EUR = 19.5-22 cm (13-16 yrs). Each GIMKOUNN pair adjusts across 3 sizes for growing feet.
faqs.q: What is the EUR to insole length chart?

faqs.a: USB rechargeable — 1 hour full charge gives 5-8 hours of continuous lighting. Each pair includes a magnetic USB cable; simply snap the connector onto the charging port on the wheel.
faqs.q: How do I charge the LED wheels?

faqs.a: Push the release button on each wheel base. No tools required — wheels pop out in seconds. Pop them back in to skate again. Great for school, mall trips, and play.
faqs.q: How do I switch between skate and sneaker mode?
